settings.heading: Conflict apparel
settings.text: The first run from the show. Tees, zip hoodies, work shirts and trucker caps, each one printed or embroidered when you order and shipped to your door.

settings.heading: The first run
settings.text: Two designs carry the first run: the 99% spade, the mark of Counter Culture Conflict, and the Conflict globe from the show's title card.
Spade tee. The spade on the left chest, and bigger across the back.
Conflict tee. The spade on the chest, the globe and the Conflict title across the back.
Trucker caps in every colour, zip hoodies and work shirts, all carrying the spade.

settings.title: Printed when you order
settings.text: Nothing sits in a warehouse. Your piece is printed or embroidered for you, usually within 2 to 5 working days.

settings.title: Free shipping
settings.text: Every apparel order ships free to the US and Canada, with tracking.

settings.title: Arrives in 1 to 2 weeks
settings.text: Each product page shows a delivery date before you buy.

settings.title: Sized right
settings.text: Every shirt has a size guide with real measurements. Still unsure? Ask us which size to pick.

settings.heading: First to know
settings.text: New designs land as the show grows. Leave your email and you hear about the next drop first. Nothing else.
